hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*ack\ *|*ag\ *) case "$CMD" in *pkg/*|*internal/*|*cmd/*|*.go*) [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify-out/graph.json exists. For structural questions about Go source \u2014 who calls X, what breaks if X changes, how A and B relate \u2014 `graphify query \"<question>\"` returns a scoped subgraph for less than a grep. For a known identifier, error string, flag or config key, grep directly: the graph is AST-only, so intent-shaped questions match bare identifiers and return noise. See CLAUDE.md \u203a Finding your way around the code."}}' || true ;; esac ;; esac

HIT=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d.get('tool_input',d);exts=('.py','.js','.ts','.tsx','.jsx','.astro','.vue','.svelte','.go','.rs','.java','.rb','.c','.h','.cpp','.hpp','.cc','.cs','.kt','.swift','.php','.scala','.lua','.sh');skip={'test','testdata','docs','vendor','node_modules','.planning','.claude','graphify-out'};vals=[str(t.get('file_path') or ''),str(t.get('pattern') or ''),str(t.get('path') or '')];j=' '.join(vals).lower().replace(chr(92),'/');segs=set(j.replace(' ','/').split('/'));tails=[('.'+x.rsplit('.',1)[-1]) for v in vals if v for x in [v.lower().replace(chr(92),'/').rsplit('/',1)[-1]] if '.' in x];hit=(not segs & skip) and '_test.go' not in j and any(tl in exts for tl in tails);sys.stdout.write('1' if hit else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ] && [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify-out/graph.json exists. Before reading several Go files to find your way around, `graphify query \"<question>\"` / `graphify explain \"<concept>\"` / `graphify path \"<A>\" \"<B>\"` name the files for you. Reading a file you already identified, or one you are about to edit, needs no graph lookup."}}'; fi || true
